3669-a-woman-hater.description: A book by Charles Reade. s, one of which he filled in every now and then, and scribbled a hasty letter to the same address. He was a sharp-faced middle-aged man of business; Joseph Ashmead, operatic and theatrical agent--at his wits' end; a female singer at the Homburg Opera had fallen really ill; he was commissioned to replace her, and had only thirty hours to do it in.

42284-love-among-the-ruins.title: Among The Ruins
42284-love-among-the-ruins.creator: Warwick Deeping
42284-love-among-the-ruins.description: A book by Warwick Deeping. Tragedy had touched the place with her ruddy hand. There had been savage deeds done in the silence of the woods. Hirelings, a rough pack of mercenaries in the service of the Lord Flavian of Gambrevault, had stolen upon the tower of Rual of Cambremont, slain him before his own gate, and put his sons to the sword.

74989-bill-porter.title: A Drama of O. Henry in Prison

arxiv-2012-06102.title: Kernel Estimator and Bandwidth Selection for Density and its Derivatives: The kedd Package
arxiv-2012-06102.creator: by Arsalane Chouaib Guidoum
arxiv-2012-06102.description: Abstract The kedd package ( Guidoum, 2015 ) providing additional smoothing techniques to the R statistical system. Although various packages on the Comprehensive R Archive Network (CRAN) provide functions useful to nonparametric statistics, kedd aims to serve as a central location for more specifically of a nonparametric functions and data sets.

arxiv-2101-02604.title: Adhesion as a trigger of droplet polarization in flowing emulsions
arxiv-2101-02604.creator: Iaroslava Golovkova, Lorraine Montel, Franck Pan, Elie Wandersman, Alexis M. Prevost, Thibault Bertrand, Léa-Laetitia Pontani
arxiv-2101-02604.description: Abstract Tissues are subjected to large external forces and undergo global deformations during morphogenesis. We use synthetic analogues of tissues to study the impact of cell-cell adhesion on the response of cohesive cellular assemblies under such stresses. In particular, we use biomimetic emulsions in which the droplets are functionalized in order to exhibit specific droplet-droplet adhesion.

arxiv-2402-06365.title: Unambiguous discrimination of sequences of quantum states
arxiv-2402-06365.creator: Tathagata Gupta, Shayeef Murshid, Somshubhro Bandyopadhyay
arxiv-2402-06365.description: Abstract We consider the problem of determining the state of an unknown quantum sequence without error. The elements of the given sequence are drawn with equal probability from a known set of linearly independent pure quantum states with the property that their mutual inner products are all real and equal.

arxiv-2411-13734.title: μ \mu RWELL detector developments at Jefferson Lab for high luminosity experiments
arxiv-2411-13734.creator: Stepan Stepanyan
arxiv-2411-13734.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Stepan Stepanyan. One of the future plans at Jefferson Lab is running electron scattering experiments with large acceptance detectors at luminosities > 10 37 ​ cm − 2 ​ s − 1 \mathrm{>10^{37}cm^{-2}s^{-1}} . These experiments allow the measurements of the Double Deeply Virtual Compton Scattering (DDVCS) reaction, an important physics process in the formalism of Generalized Parton Distributions, which has never been measured because of its small cross-section.

arxiv-2503-14942.title: Real Eigenvalues of Asymmetric Wishart Matrices: Expected Number, Global Density and Integrable Structure
arxiv-2503-14942.creator: Sung-Soo Byun, and, Kohei Noda
arxiv-2503-14942.description: Abstract We investigate the real eigenvalues of asymmetric Wishart matrices of size N N , indexed by the rectangular parameter ν ∈ ℕ \nu\in\mathbb{N} and the non-Hermiticity parameter τ ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] \tau\in[0,1] . The rectangular parameter ν \nu is either fixed or proportional to N N .

arxiv-2506-01453.title: From Initial Data to Boundary Layers: Neural Networks for Nonlinear Hyperbolic Conservation Laws
arxiv-2506-01453.creator: Igor CIRIL, Khalil HADDAOUI, Yohann TENDERO
arxiv-2506-01453.description: Abstract We address the approximation of entropy solutions to initial-boundary value problems for nonlinear strictly hyperbolic conservation laws using neural networks. A general and systematic framework is introduced for the design of efficient and reliable learning algorithms, combining fast convergence during training with accurate predictions.

arxiv-2507-01553.title: A reentrancy of motility-induced phase separation in overdamped active Brownian particles
arxiv-2507-01553.creator: Hiroya Yamamoto
arxiv-2507-01553.description: Abstract In a system of Self-Propelled Particles (SPPs), the combination of self-propulsion and excluded volume effects can result in a phase separation called Motility-Induced Phase Separation (MIPS). Previous studies reported that MIPS is one of the phenomena so-called ”reentrant phase separation” ,i.e., MIPS is suppressed when the Péclet number P ​ e Pe (dimensionless self-propelled speed) is sufficiently large.

arxiv-2507-09034.title: Photon-Number-Resolving Detector Based on a Cascade of Waveguide-Coupled Quantum Emitters
arxiv-2507-09034.creator: Abdolreza Pasharavesh, Sai Sreesh Venuturumilli, Michal Bajcsy
arxiv-2507-09034.description: Abstract We investigate the operation of a photon-number-resolving (PNR) detector consisting of a cascade of waveguide-coupled Λ \Lambda -type emitters, where each waveguide-coupled emitter extracts a single photon from the input light and sends it to a single-photon detector. Using Green’s function and input-output formalisms, we derive the scattering matrices and photon-photon correlators for individual scatterers.

arxiv-2508-14004.title: GDNSQ: Gradual Differentiable Noise Scale Quantization for Low-bit Neural Networks
arxiv-2508-14004.creator: Sergey Salishev, Ian Akhremchik
arxiv-2508-14004.description: Abstract . Quantized neural networks can be viewed as a chain of noisy channels, where rounding in each layer reduces capacity as bit-width shrinks; the floating-point (FP) checkpoint sets the maximum input rate. We track capacity dynamics as the average bit-width decreases and identify resulting quantization bottlenecks by casting fine-tuning as a smooth, constrained optimization problem.

arxiv-2509-09465.title: Enhancing Optical Imaging via Quantum Computation
arxiv-2509-09465.creator: Aleksandr Mokeev, Babak Saif, Mikhail D. Lukin, Johannes Borregaard
arxiv-2509-09465.description: Abstract Extracting information from weak optical signals is a critical challenge across a broad range of technologies. Conventional imaging techniques, constrained to integrating over detected signals and classical post-processing, are limited in signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) from shot noise accumulation in the post-processing algorithms.

The invertebrate ornamental fishery in the State of Florida, with increasing catches over a more diverse array of speci

plos-pone-0011947.creator: Radhika Nair, Simon Junankar, Sandra O'Toole et al.
plos-pone-0011947.description: PLOS ONE research article. The accumulation of poorly differentiated cells is a hallmark of breast neoplasia and progression. Thus an understanding of the factors controlling mammary differentiation is critical to a proper understanding of breast tumourigenesis. The Inhibitor of Differentiation 1 (Id1) pro

pmc-10591636.title: O045 Sleep Duration is Associated with Young Adult's Heart Rate Variability Response to Stress
pmc-10591636.creator: S Gadam, K Rossa, C Pattinson, S Shekari Soleimanloo, D Mann, P Salmon, K Sullivan, S Smith
pmc-10591636.description: IntroductionYoung adulthood is a critical developmental period typified by heightened exposure to stress, and a tendency towards insufficient sleep. The relationship between sleep loss and stress may have lifelong health consequences. Currently, our understanding of this relationship in young adults is limited. Heart rate variability (HRV) is an important indicator of balance in the autonomic nervous system.

pmc-10595795.title: FeMFit: Feasibility of tracking the menstrual cycle using digital questionnaires and wearable devices
pmc-10595795.creator: A Lang, R Bruhn, M Fehling, A Heidenreich, I Khanyaree, M Henningsen, C Remschmidt
pmc-10595795.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). IntroductionDespite its importance to female reproductive health and its impact on women's daily lives, the menstrual cycle and its effects on health remain poorly studied. Conventional clinical trials rely on infrequent in-person assessments.

pmc-10608169.title: Curcumin Nanoemulsion: Unveiling Cardioprotective Effects via ACE Inhibition and Antioxidant Properties in Hypertensive Rats
pmc-10608169.creator: Mohd Ishaq, Mohemmed Faraz Khan, Garima Verma, Akshoo Rathi, Mohammad Adil, Mohammad Faizan, Abul Kalam Najmi, Mohd Akhtar, Omkulthom Al kamaly, Samar Zuhair Alshawwa, Abdelaaty A Shahat, Abdulsalam Alhalmi, Stefano De Servi
pmc-10608169.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Background and Objectives: Curcumin, derived from Curcuma longa, is a well-known traditional medicinal compound recognized for its therapeutic attributes. Nevertheless, its efficacy is hampered by limited bioavailability, prompting researchers to explore the application of nanoemulsion as a potential alternative. Materials and Methods: This study delves into the antihypertensive effects of curcumin nanoemulsion (SNEC) by targeting the renin-angiotensin-aldosterone system (RAAS) and oxidative stress in deoxycorticosterone acetate (DOCA) salt-induced hypertensive rats.

pmc-11418350.title: Cannabis Use, Perspectives, and Experiences Among Patients Receiving Hemodialysis: A Descriptive Patient Survey
pmc-11418350.creator: Josephine Ho, Jennifer Harrison, Marisa Battistella
pmc-11418350.description: Background:Patients with chronic kidney disease experience high burden of symptoms, negatively affecting their quality of life. Medication therapy is often initiated to address these symptoms but is limited by variable efficacy and high pill burden. There is interest among clinicians and patients to explore cannabis and cannabinoids as an alternative treatment to manage symptoms related to kidney disease.

pmc-12473497.title: Robust Audio–Visual Speaker Localization in Noisy Aircraft Cabins for Inflight Medical Assistance
pmc-12473497.creator: Qiwu Qin, Yian Zhu, Carlos M Travieso-González
pmc-12473497.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Active Speaker Localization (ASL) involves identifying both who is speaking and where they are speaking from within audiovisual content. This capability is crucial in constrained and acoustically challenging environments, such as aircraft cabins during in-flight medical emergencies. In this paper, we propose a novel end-to-end Cross-Modal Audio–Visual Fusion Network (CMAVFN) designed specifically for ASL under real-world aviation conditions, which are characterized by engine noise, dynamic lighting, occlusions from seats or oxygen masks, and frequent speaker turnover.

pmc-12507714.title: Multi-omics analysis identifies the unique high-FDCSP basal cells in triple-negative breast cancer
pmc-12507714.creator: Xinya Lu, Zhen Chen, Ying Shao
pmc-12507714.description: Follicular dendritic cell secreted protein (FDCSP) is highly expressed in various cancers and has been implicated in tumor migration and invasion, yet its role in triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) remains poorly understood. Our findings revealed that FDCSP expression was significantly elevated in TNBC compared to normal breast tissue, whereas its expression was significantly reduced in non-TNBC.

pmc-12604167.title: HighFold-MeD: a Rosetta distillation model to accelerate structure prediction of cyclic peptides with backbone N-methylation and d-amino acids
pmc-12604167.creator: Zhigang Cao, Sen Cao, Linghong Wang, Zhiguo Wang, Qingyi Mao, Jingjing Guo, Hongliang Duan
pmc-12604167.description: AbstractCyclic peptides with backbone N-methylated amino acids (BNMeAAs) and D-amino acids (D-AAs) have gained increasing attention for their stability, membrane permeability, and other therapeutic potentials. Currently, Rosetta simple_cycpep_predict (SCP) can predict their structures through energy-based calculations, but this approach is computationally intensive and time-consuming.

pmc-12663209.title: Equitable colorectal cancer screening implementation framework via a modified Delphi Consensus for Romanian healthcare
pmc-12663209.creator: Ionut Negoi, The SCREECO study group
pmc-12663209.description: Colorectal cancer (CRC) continues to be a predominant cause of cancer-related mortality on a global scale. Screening for early detection plays a crucial role in significantly reducing both incidence and mortality rates. However, screening uptake varies widely across regions due to disparities in healthcare resources and implementation of screening programs.

pmc-12988647.title: Outcomes of Liver Transplantation Without Alcohol Abstinence in Alcohol-Associated Hepatitis With Original MELD Score ≥30
pmc-12988647.creator: Hao-Chien Hung, Tsung-Han Wu, Yin Lai, Jin-Chiao Lee, Yu-Chao Wang, Chih-Hsien Cheng, Chen-Fang Lee, Ting-Jung Wu, Hong-Shiue Chou, Kun-Ming Chan, Wei-Chen Lee
pmc-12988647.description: BackgroundAchieving alcohol abstinence before standard liver transplantation (SLT) for alcohol-associated liver disease (ALD) is commonly accepted. However, the 3-month mortality rate for alcohol-associated hepatitis (AH) patients with extremely high Model for End-Stage Liver Disease (MELD) scores (≥30) exceeds 50%, suggesting insufficient time for these patients to achieve sobriety.

pmc-13217409.title: Redefining Boundaries—Safety of Radiation Therapy in the Presence of Orthotopic Neobladder
pmc-13217409.creator: Alexander Ho, Salah Dajani, Poonam Yadav, John Kalapurakal, Shilajit Kundu, Joshua Meeks, Sean Sachdev
pmc-13217409.description: IntroductionPelvic radiation therapy in patients with neobladder reconstruction following cystectomy is rare but encountered in clinical practice. Its potential impact on neobladder function remains underexplored in the current literature.Methods and MaterialsWe conducted a retrospective study of patients with urothelial carcinoma who underwent cystectomy with neobladder reconstruction, followed by pelvic radiation therapy. Radiation dosimetric data pertaining to the neobladder were analyzed.

pmc-13259735.title: Premenstrual syndrome, premenstrual dysphoric disorder, and coping strategies in women with menstrual migraine
pmc-13259735.creator: Alshimaa S. Othman, Mona Hussein, Alaa Elmazny, Salsabil Abo Al-Azayem, Azza Elashiry, Mennat-Allah Tarek, Heba Qassim Shamardal, Sara El-Sayed Abd El-Ghani, Mohamed Wagdy, Eman Hany Elsebaie, Doaa Lotfy Abd El Baky, Rehab Magdy
pmc-13259735.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Background and objectivesDespite the considerable prevalence of premenstrual syndrome (PMS) in women with migraine, little attention has been given to the applied premenstrual coping strategies and their impact on headache severity, especially in menstrual migraine (MM).

pmc-13404674.title: Antibiofilm Activity of Three Essential Oils Against ESBL-Producing Klebsiella pneumoniae: An In Vitro and In Silico Investigation of Putative Molecular Targets
pmc-13404674.creator: Karim Bariz, Bilal Saoudi, Souad Lahcene, Idir Moualek, Hillal Sebbane, Fares Rekbi, Hakim Belkhalfa, Assia Derguini, Nasir A. Ibrahim, Sulaiman Abdullah Ali Alsalamah, Mohammed Saad Aleissa, Nosiba S. Basher, Lamia Trabelsi, Karim Houali
